policies.description: SSH root 계정 직접 로그인 허용 여부
policies.reference: 판정 기준: 취약점 점검 기준표 v1.1 SSH-01 (2026-11-09 팀장 판정 기준 승인) / policy_version 1.0은 정책 파일 형식 버전

vulnerable_values.yes: root login is allowed with password and public key authentication
vulnerable_values.prohibit-password: root login is allowed with public key authentication (password login blocked)
vulnerable_values.without-password: legacy name of prohibit-password; root login is allowed with public key authentication
vulnerable_values.forced-commands-only: root login is allowed with public key authentication for forced commands only
